_comment: Receiver policy library (Sec 3.3). Monotone AND/OR threshold policies, amount-tiered. Tiers in USD: micro < 100, standard < 1000, high < 10000, very_high >= 10000.

liberal.standard: auth_strength >= A1 AND (credential_age >= 7d OR device_continuity >= established)
liberal.high: (auth_strength >= A3 AND credential_age >= 7d) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND account_age >= 365d AND device_continuity >= established)
liberal.very_high: (auth_strength >= A3 AND phishing_resistant >= true AND dynamic_binding >= true AND credential_age >= 7d) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND dynamic_binding >= true AND device_continuity >= established AND account_age >= 365d)

moderate.micro: auth_strength >= A1 AND (credential_age >= 1d OR device_continuity >= established)
moderate.standard: (auth_strength >= A3 AND credential_age >= 7d) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND account_age >= 365d AND device_continuity >= established)
moderate.high: (auth_strength >= A3 AND phishing_resistant >= true AND dynamic_binding >= true AND credential_age >= 7d) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND dynamic_binding >= true AND device_continuity >= established AND account_age >= 365d)
moderate.very_high: (auth_strength >= A3 AND phishing_resistant >= true AND dynamic_binding >= true AND credential_age >= 30d AND fraud_policy_executed >= true) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND dynamic_binding >= true AND device_continuity >= established AND account_age >= 730d AND identity_assurance >= L2 AND fraud_policy_executed >= true)

conservative.micro: auth_strength >= A2 OR (auth_strength >= A1 AND device_continuity >= established AND credential_age >= 7d)
conservative.standard: (auth_strength >= A3 AND phishing_resistant >= true AND dynamic_binding >= true AND credential_age >= 7d) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND dynamic_binding >= true AND device_continuity >= established AND account_age >= 365d)
conservative.high: (auth_strength >= A3 AND phishing_resistant >= true AND dynamic_binding >= true AND credential_age >= 30d AND fraud_policy_executed >= true) OR (auth_strength >= A2 AND dynamic_binding >= true AND device_continuity >= established AND account_age >= 730d AND identity_assurance >= L2 AND fraud_policy_executed >= true)
conservative.very_high: (auth_strength >= A3 AND phishing_resistant >= true AND dynamic_binding >= true AND credential_age >= 30d AND fraud_policy_executed >= true AND identity_assurance >= L2) OR (auth_strength >= A3 AND dynamic_binding >= true AND device_continuity >= established AND account_age >= 730d AND identity_assurance >= L3 AND fraud_policy_executed >= true)
